description: Copies files from another app of the developer (`fromAppId`, read as being edited) into this app's draft, overwriting paths it already has. Stops at the target's file cap. Returns `copied`, `notCopied` and `missing` (content the source lost: upload again). Waits in that env's draft until neblla_promote "save" with the same env ("pro": the users); "discard" drops that whole draft. More: neblla_get_llms tools/copy_files

appId.description: The target app, which gets the files.

env.description: "pro" (the published app, what users have) or "pre" (the private test copy); left out: the environment the developer picked for this app in the panel.

fromAppId.description: The source app; not the same as appId.

message.description: Note naming this version in neblla_versions.

paths.description: Only these paths (default every file); an unknown path fails the call.

name: neblla_copy_files
title: Copy files between apps
